gist.headline: One More Name in the Hive
gist.blurb: Creatneworld has been added to the project’s GitHub identity list. The garden gate recognizes another familiar face.
gist.summary: Added Creatneworld to the shared GitHub ID allowlist used by project authentication.
gist.impact: This gives the Creatneworld GitHub account access wherever the shared allowlist is used.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden gate with a small pixel ID list pinned beside it, where Polli in a tiny gardener hat warmly adds a new name; flowers and a code-plant make the access-list change feel like welcoming a contributor into the hive.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush and light blue wings, wearing a tiny gardener hat while adding a new name to a pixel clipboard beside a welcoming garden gate and blooming code-plants; lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently on the gate and list, with warm cream, mint, and lavender surroundings. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle pixel-font text: "WELCOME".
